worldcombat.skill.rollout.summary: Curl into a stone ball and roll into the target again and again: every landed pass doubles the next one's power (up to 5 passes), and a hit knocks the target away, so you have to close in to keep going. A whiff or any other committed move wipes the chain.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.description.0: Each pass deals %1$s contact damage; the chain runs up to %2$s passes and simply spends itself at the end.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.description.1: Each pass hits for %1$s, reaches %2$s blocks with a %3$s-block hitbox, and knocks the target %4$s blocks away.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.description.2: On a hit the ball bounces back %1$s blocks; keep rolling within %2$s to keep the chain and double the next pass.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.heavy.on: Heavy ball: each landed pass multiplies the next by 2.35 and the chain window runs 8 ticks longer; costs 5% hit chance per pass, 0.92x rolling reach, 0.9x lunge, +1 tick preparation, +2 ticks recovery and +8 ticks cooldown - a heavier roll, though harder to keep going and dearer.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.heavy.off: Light ball (the native form): 2x per pass, 2% more hit chance, longer rolling and lunge distance, a shorter recovery and 4 ticks less cooldown; at a lower per-pass power ceiling - a smoother and cheaper roll.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.growth.0: From level %1$s each pass rises to %2$s and the chain window extends to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.growth.1: From level %1$s each pass rises to %2$s and the rolling reach extends to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.rollout.use.0: Roll into the target one pass after another
worldcombat.skill.rollout.use.1: Double the next pass on every landed hit
worldcombat.skill.rollout.use.2: Lose the chain to a whiff or another move
worldcombat.skill.rollout.preference.hea: On (heavy): each landed pass multiplies by 2.35 (a higher ceiling), at -5% hit chance per pass, shorter rolling and lunge distance, +2 ticks recovery and +8 ticks cooldown. Off (light, the native form): 2x per pass, +2% hit chance, longer and smoother rolls, shorter recovery and cooldown, at a lower ceiling.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of rolling. Larger values open the chain from further out.
On: while it carries the roll chain it prefers to keep rolling and extend the string. Off: it ranks the move as an ordinary mid-range tackle either way.
world_combat.move.rollout.text.miss: Rollout whiffed; the chain is gone
world_combat.move.rollout.text.cap: Rollout ran its %1$s passes and spent itself
